ws_input_bindings.WS1: repository snapshot SHA-256 recomputed and bound
ws_input_bindings.WS2: classification SHA-256 recomputed, WS1 binding checked
ws_input_bindings.WS3: effective applicability SHA-256 recomputed, WS2 binding checked

plan_identity: PLAN- plus first 16 hex characters of deterministic frozen plan body SHA-256; repository ID is not reused as plan identity.
freeze_model: Plan is serialized as FROZEN before request generation. Inputs changing after freeze return PLAN_INPUT_CHANGED; no in-place repair or mutation occurs.

projections.support: SUPPORTED_AUTOMATED, SUPPORTED_HYBRID, HUMAN_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, or NOT_IMPLEMENTED; never changes applicability.
projections.evidence: Scope-derived authoritative evidence requirements only; no evidence resolution.
projections.targets: REPOSITORY controls AUTHORITATIVE_EVALUATION; non-repository scopes PROJECTED without fabricated repository authority.
projections.human_review: anticipated requirements only, for unresolved applicability, human evidence, and unimplemented support.

known_limitations: WS4 does not compose evaluator requests, resolve evidence, verify checkouts, execute evaluators, or make compliance/outcome decisions.
